chosen.premise: Lickitung can lick filth clean, but everything it licks always stinks afterward.
chosen.hook: Lickitung cleans dirt by licking it—and makes the result stink.
chosen.visualIdea: Split-screen: grime disappears from an object while stink lines and a foul-smell label appear.
chosen.note: A sharp, concrete contradiction directly stated in the Pokédex: it cleans filth but leaves everything smelling worse. Excellent hook and visual payoff.

candidates.premise: Lickitung’s tongue is twice its body length and functions like an arm instead of hands.
candidates.hook: Lickitung doesn’t need hands—it has a tongue twice its body length.
candidates.visualIdea: Measure Lickitung beside its tongue, then animate the tongue grabbing food like an arm.
candidates.note: A highly Lickitung-specific body-function contradiction, with clear measurements and strong visual action.

candidates.premise: Lickitung’s saliva becomes a strong, useful adhesive after being collected and boiled down.
candidates.hook: Boil down Lickitung’s saliva, and you get industrial-strength glue.
candidates.visualIdea: Show viscous saliva collected in a container, boiled down, then transforming into adhesive that bonds two objects.
candidates.note: A strong transformation premise with excellent visuals, but 'industrial-strength glue' overstates the source, which only calls it a strong and useful adhesive.

candidates.premise: Extending Lickitung’s tongue retracts its tail, while another entry says the tail quivers.
candidates.hook: Lickitung’s tongue and tail may be connected by one strange rule.
candidates.visualIdea: Extend the tongue in stages while the tail retracts, then flash the quivering-tail clue as a connection diagram.
candidates.note: Very intriguing and visual, but the idea that the tongue and tail are definitively connected is framed as only a possibility, so the premise should remain a mystery rather than a fact.

candidates.premise: Lickitung evolves into Lickilicky only by leveling up while knowing Rollout.
candidates.hook: Lickitung’s evolution has one oddly specific requirement: know Rollout.
candidates.visualIdea: Display Lickitung’s level-up meter locked, then unlock evolution when a Rollout move icon appears.
candidates.note: An unusually specific evolution requirement and easy to visualize, though the cited method is from trusted secondary data rather than the Pokédex entries.

candidates.premise: Lickitung investigates unfamiliar objects by licking them, then remembers them through texture and taste.
candidates.hook: Lickitung doesn’t inspect new things—it tastes them to remember.
candidates.visualIdea: Show unknown objects entering frame as Lickitung licks each one, forming a texture-and-taste memory trail.
candidates.note: Distinctive and well-supported, though the memory concept is less immediately visual and lacks a single striking number or rule.

rounds.request: None; the chosen angle is already strong. Stronger alternatives would need an equally specific contradiction or rule, direct source support, and an immediate visual transformation without overstating the evidence.
